notes.title: Announcement on fixing and compensating for bugs during server launch
notes.content:
Hello everyone, bosses!

Firstly, thank you all for your attention and support. Due to the technician secretly signing a female anchor to play while fixing a bug, bringing their own files into the update package, some players who entered the game before 11:37 had their saved files overwritten. The known issue has been resolved, and the person who caused the problem has had a set of signed photos confiscated. The production team once again extends sincere apologies to the affected players. [u] [b] Any affected players can join the official QQ group with their purchase records before 11:37 to contact the official and receive a copy of the "Actor&Guest Appearance Complete Set Seal" peripheral [/b] [/u].

(Official QQ Group 2 826706420)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162920/7e51d91a826651cd7cbbc46d8c7669539cb25304.png[/img]

In addition, since the server was launched nearly 5 hours ago, we have received enthusiastic feedback from many players about some bugs in the game and have completed urgent fixes.

The game has been updated and the fixed bugs are:
1. Solved the problem of fragmented graphics in some games
2. Fixed the bug where 2K resource packs cause black screens
3. Solved the bug in the first chapter where some of the images were not synchronized in terms of sound and image
4. Fixed the bug of abnormal cloud archiving

Thank you for your understanding and support. Wishing you both a fruitful love and career. Have a great game!

notes.title: "Half Billion" will be officially released on October 18th with a 20% discount
notes.content:
Thank you for your continued attention and support. The ultra-realistic second-generation rich love simulator "Starting with 500 Million" will be officially released on October 18, 2024!

You can enjoy a 20% discount in the first two weeks of release.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162920/5b5f39717c4f22da5a5c67dc20ea7c853775c461.png[/img]
"Starting with 500 Million" is a ultra-realistic simulation business interactive video game. As the protagonist, you will complete the entrepreneurial journey of 500 million yuan in start-up capital. In this adventure centered on money and love, six beauties with different identities and types will participate in your career with their own purposes. When love and career are intertwined, how will you balance the relationship between you and them? How will you choose if you are busy starting a business?

[h3]Experience real entrepreneurship, "career" and "love" dual main lines[/h3]
Players will start with 500 million start-up funds and start the dual main lines of entrepreneurship and love. According to the player's investment decision, different wealth returns will be formed, which will in turn affect the emotional ending of the heroine
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162920/c4ff030aee501ebda65f2f2d318d438a827d4ffc.jpg[/img]

[h3]Super first-line Internet celebrities & powerful actors join hands to bring you a high-quality entrepreneurial heartbeat adventure[/h3]
Mai Baolai, Wen Xin, Chen Siche, Li Xinai, Liu Mengru and other powerful actors starred, Hua Suihua, DJ Jiang Xiaobai, Milk Princess Xiao Zhang, You Yiran, Jenny, Liu Yilin, Xiao Yueyue, Banbanjiang, Swan, car model Potato Si and other well-known Internet celebrity anchors participated. In the game, they will play beauties with different personalities and accompany you on your entrepreneurial journey.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162920/c5ae485457bc747371730bfde5b2fe0f427df181.jpg[/img]
Spending money can not only unlock exclusive plots with them, but you can even...sign them to become anchors of your company to work for you.

[h3]First-person hyper-realistic interactive love experience[/h3]
During the game, as the protagonist's wealth and career change, the actor's portrayal of the character's inner world at different stages is gradually revealed. The changes in the heroine's attitude and demands on the hero at different stages will affect the player's love experience. And what choice will you make when faced with the temptations of six beauties with different personalities? Share the achievements and troubles on the road to entrepreneurship with your favorite girl.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162920/11609bb8ec98e56bef2f56e7a7eaa4733d6a6233.png[/img]

PS: This game has more than 100 "memes" that reflect prototype events in the plot. There are not only "entertainment memes" and "event memes", but also some "professional memes" that players are looking forward to discovering on their own.

A relaxing and sweet love journey is about to begin. See you on October 18, 2024.

notes.title: 能用钱解决的问题都不是问题！ 《开局五个亿》今日开放预约！
notes.content:
人生苦短，享受过程难道有什么错吗？ 超现实富二代恋爱模拟器Steam游戏《开局五个亿》心愿单今日开放预约~！欢迎关注官方账号，获取最新情报福利   

官方QQ群：1005779185
抖音：开局五个亿
B站：开局五个亿
微博：开局五个亿
微信视频号：开局五个亿
快手：开局五个亿


[h2]【游戏简介】 [/h2]
《开局五个亿》是一款超现实模拟经营类互动影像游戏，你将以主角的身份，完成启动资金五个亿的创业历程。在这场围绕金钱和爱情展开的冒险中，六位怀着各自目的，身份、类型各异的美女将参与到你的事业之中，当感情和事业相互交织，你将如何平衡与她们之间的关系？忙于创业的你又将如何选择？ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162920/1945e9008c7cc2915a410676cf621702e8b2c659.png[/img]

[h2]【游戏特色】 [/h2]

[h3]■ 真实创业体验，“事业”“爱情”双主线 [/h3]
根据玩家投资决策，形成不同的财富收益，进而影响女主的感情结局。更真实体验游戏中“事业”与“爱情”双主线相互交织的关系，不同于其他男频恋爱类互动影游，本游戏更注重模拟经营创业的真实过程，大量呈现了爱情和事业的两难选择，更贴近现实生活。 
[h3]■ “事业”亦是“爱情”，第一人称超现实互动恋爱体验 [/h3]
游戏过程中随着主角财富值和事业的变化对应逐步揭示了演员不同阶段对角色内心世界的心路刻画。不同阶段下女主态度和对男主诉求的变化将影响玩家恋爱体验。 
[h3]■ 超一线网红&实力派演员携手，高质量创业心跳大冒险 [/h3]
温心，梅宝莱，陈思澈，李心爱，刘梦茹等实力派演员主演，花碎花，DJ江小白，牛奶公主小章，是你依然，詹妮Jenny，刘一琳，小玥玥，板板酱，Swan，车模土豆丝等知名网红主播参演。 
在游戏中她们将扮演或妩媚、或柔情、或无邪、或任性，亦或性感火热，高贵冷艳，性格迥异的美女，陪伴你的创业之路。 
[h3]■ 百余种故事分支，多条隐藏故事暗线与彩蛋 [/h3]
产品为您设计了百余种故事分支，多条隐藏故事暗线与彩蛋。“财富”和“情商”同样重要，在游戏中收集各种成就、挖掘她们的秘密，做出最符合本心的选择，而不是最可能是正确的选择将为你带来意想不到的收获。 

PS：本游戏在剧情中穿插了超过100余个映射原型事件的“梗”，不仅有“娱乐梗”和“事件梗”更有部分“专业梗”期待玩家们自行挖掘~
